The '''Agamar family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of the family's members was [[Gareth Agamar]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], who was part of a long line of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and pilots in the Agamar family.<ref name="Strongholds" />
